title: Add directive support to all diagrams by preprocessing
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Removes the directive grammar from the jison files.
Directives, frontmatter and comments will be preprocessed and removed, before parsing. 
Hence, all diagrams will now support directives.

Resolves #4755 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

A preprocess step was added, which will extract metadata and remove comments, directives and frontmatter. 
wrap and title needed to be handled separately for legacy support.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

```ts
/**
 * @param metadata - Diagram metadata, defined in YAML.
```

Also, we should probably defined the `{title?: string}` type somewhere once, e.g. with something like:

```ts
type DiagramMetadata = {title?: string};
```

(maybe this should be `type DiagramMetadata = {title?: string, config?: MermaidConfig};` since https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/4750 has been merged?)

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
> Wrap makes the text wrap on messages for instance.

Ah, that makes sense!

FYI, there is a [`MermaidConfig.wrap`](https://mermaid.js.org/config/schema-docs/config.html#wrap) value, but the documentation for it is empty, which is why I got a bit confused!

However, [`MermaidConfig.c4.wrap`](https://mermaid.js.org/config/schema-docs/config.html#wrap-1), and [`MermaidConfig.sequence.wrap`](https://mermaid.js.org/config/schema-docs/config.html#wrap-2) are documented.

---

> I see, but does it has to be inside the DB?
> Can't we just use `getConfig`?

They're currently two separate values (but it's probably okay to refactor this in a future PR).

If somebody does:

```mermaid-example
%%{init: {'sequence': {'wrap': false}}}%%
%%{wrap}%%
sequenceDiagram
    Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? I am writing a verrrrrrrrrrrry long text.
```

```mermaid
%%{init: {'sequence': {'wrap': false}}}%%
%%{wrap}%%
sequenceDiagram
    Alice->>+John: Hello John, how are you? I am writing a verrrrrrrrrrrry long text.
```

You'd expect `getConfig().sequence.wrap === false`, because that's what the `%%{init: {'sequence': {'wrap': false}}}%%` bit says.

However, the `%%{wrap}%%` is part of the DB, so it would be `true` in the DB.

To be honest, the only main difference I see is that a website could set `siteConfig.secure = ["wrap"]` to block people from modifying the `wrap` config value in a diagram, then doing  `%%{init: {'sequence': {'wrap': true}}}%%` won't work, but `%%{wrap}%%` will work, but I don't really see why anybody would want to do that.

Anyway, if we do want to move `wrap` out of the DB and just keep it in the `config`, that should be separate PR to keep things simple :)
